newsitem.title: DUBAI: GCC head meets Bahrain emir ahead of Gulf summit.
newsitem.headline: GCC head meets Bahrain emir ahead of Gulf summit.

text.p: The head of the Gulf Cooperation Council met Bahrain's emir, Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa, on Wednesday ahead of next month's GCC summit that Manama has threatened to boycott.
Bahrain's official news agency GNA said Jameel Hujilan briefed Sheikh Isa on the November 9 meeting of GCC foreign ministers, which Bahrain did not attend.
In a separate meeting, Hujilan handed Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammad bin Mubarak al-Khalifa "draft resolutions related" to the meeting he skipped, GNA added.

Manama, locked in a territorial dispute with Qatar, has not said if it will drop its threat to boycott the December 7-9 GCC summit in Doha. The GCC also includes Saudi Arabia, Oman, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait.

Last month it threatened not to attend unless Doha withdrew a lawsuit it has filed at the International Court of Justice at The Hague over a number of barren islands, sandbanks and reefs controlled by Bahrain but also claimed by Qatar.
Qatar has rejected Bahrain's threat, saying it would only withdraw the case if Saudi mediation to resolve the dispute succeeded.
